examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真上|まうえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦ヘリコプター→ヘリコプター：05117_herikoputaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真上|まうえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}んでいる→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: A helicopter is flying right above.
My neighbor's room is directly above my room.

notes:
{真上|まうえ} combines the prefix {真|ま} (true, exact) with ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧ (above), meaning "directly above" with no deviation to either side. It emphasizes precision of position.

FORMS:
The prefix {真|ま} attaches to direction and position words to mean "directly" or "right at":
- ⟦{真下|ました}→真下：07785_mashita⟧: directly below
- ⟦{真横|まよこ}→真横：16717_mayoko⟧: directly beside
- ⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧: right in the middle
- {真正面|ましょうめん}: directly in front
- {真後|まうし}ろ: directly behind

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {真上|まうえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: directly above (location)
- {真上|まうえ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from directly above
- {真上|まうえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見上|みあ}げる→見上げる：04567_miageru⟧: to look straight up
